title: Zscaler CEO Highlights AI Security Surge, Zero-Trust Momentum at Citi Conference
excerpt: Zscaler (NASDAQ:ZS) CEO and Founder Jay Chaudhry said the company entered fiscal 2027 with an expanded product portfolio, improving sales momentum and growin...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Zscaler, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • AI security and zero-trust demand are accelerating: Zscaler expanded its AI-security portfolio from one product to six, with security-for-AI bookings exceeding $100 million over the disclosed 12-month period. However, many customers are starting with smaller purchases before committing to larger deployments.

  • Sales momentum and customer adoption improved: Net-new ARR growth rose from 7% in fiscal 2025 to 17% in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, while customers using Zero Trust Everywhere increased from 300 to 950. Zscaler also reported record million-dollar deals, pipeline and sales productivity.

  • Fiscal 2027 priorities include agentic security and flexible purchasing: Zscaler launched Agentic SecOps using technology from Red Canary and introduced Z Flex, which generated 30% higher upsell among participating customers in its first year. The company expects AI security, Zero Trust Everywhere and its Agentic Exchange to drive future upside.

  • Palo Alto vs. Zscaler: Which Cybersecurity Stock Looks Stronger After Earnings?

Zscaler (NASDAQ:ZS) CEO and Founder Jay Chaudhry said the company entered fiscal 2027 with an expanded product portfolio, improving sales momentum and growing customer interest in AI security and zero-trust architecture.

Speaking at Citi's TMT Conference with Fatima Boolani, Chaudhry said Zscaler's platform now spans zero trust for users, branches, devices, workloads and agents. He said the company also expanded its AI-security lineup from one product a year ago, GenAI Security, to six integrated products.

→ MarketBeat Week in Review – 09/07 - 09/11

  • Zscaler's Strong Quarter Still Left Investors Waiting on 1 Key Signal

"We have better portfolio platform than anyone out there," Chaudhry said, adding that the pace of product development by Zscaler's internal AI-security startup exceeded his expectations.

Sales transformation and customer metrics

Chaudhry said the company's sales transformation, initiated roughly 2.5 years ago after Mike Rich joined the organization, has shifted the go-to-market process toward enterprise-account focus. He pointed to improvement in net-new annual recurring revenue growth as evidence of progress.

  • Net-new ARR growth was limited in fiscal 2024, according to Chaudhry.

  • Growth reached 7% in fiscal 2025.

  • It rose to 10% in the first half of fiscal 2026 and 17% in the fourth quarter.

→ Rocket Lab Tackles a Supply Chain Bottleneck as the Stock Hunts for a Bottom. Time to Buy?
